notes: The alternative marginal rendering (*There shall be one . . .*) and the gloss *Hebrew a righteous one* were read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
`yirʾaṯ ʾĕlōhîm` is an adverbial accusative of manner, not the object of `môšēl`, so the supplied *in* belongs to the noun under rule 33 rather than to the participle under rule 44.
